exit: 0
--- stdout
sequence multizone_vav_economizer_limits_common
derived_from none
param controllerType : SimpleController = SimpleController.PI
param k : Real = 0.05
param Ti : Real = 120.0
param Td : Real = 0.1
param uRetDam_min : Real = 0.5
param retDamPhy_max : Real = 1.0
param retDamPhy_min : Real = 0.0
param outDamPhy_max : Real = 1.0
param outDamPhy_min : Real = 0.0
in VOut_flow_normalized : Real @unit 1
in VOutMinSet_flow_normalized : Real @unit 1
in uOpeMod : Integer
in u1SupFan : Boolean
out yOutDam_min : Real @unit 1 @min 0.0 @max 1.0
out yOutDam_max : Real @unit 1 @min 0.0 @max 1.0
out yRetDam_min : Real @unit 1 @min 0.0 @max 1.0
out yRetDam_max : Real @unit 1 @min 0.0 @max 1.0
out yRetDamPhy_max : Real @unit 1 @min 0.0 @max 1.0
out yEnaMinOut : Boolean
block damLimCon = CDL.Reals.PIDWithReset(
  controllerType = controllerType,
  k = k,
  Ti = Ti,
  Td = Td,
  yMax = 1.0,
  yMin = 0.0,
  y_reset = 0.0
)
block outDamPhyPosMinSig = CDL.Reals.Sources.Constant(k = outDamPhy_min)
block outDamPhyPosMaxSig = CDL.Reals.Sources.Constant(k = outDamPhy_max)
block retDamPhyPosMinSig = CDL.Reals.Sources.Constant(k = retDamPhy_min)
block retDamPhyPosMaxSig = CDL.Reals.Sources.Constant(k = retDamPhy_max)
block minSigLim = CDL.Reals.Sources.Constant(k = 0.0)
block maxSigLim = CDL.Reals.Sources.Constant(k = 1.0)
block sigFraForOutDam = CDL.Reals.Sources.Constant(k = uRetDam_min)
block minOutDam = CDL.Reals.Line(limitBelow = true, limitAbove = true)
block minRetDam = CDL.Reals.Line(limitBelow = true, limitAbove = true)
block retDamPosMinSwitch = CDL.Reals.Switch
block outDamPosMaxSwitch = CDL.Reals.Switch
block not1 = CDL.Logical.Not
block conInt1 = CDL.Integers.Sources.Constant(k = OperationModes.occupied)
block intEqu = CDL.Integers.Equal
block and3 = CDL.Logical.And
VOut_flow_normalized -> damLimCon.u_m
VOutMinSet_flow_normalized -> damLimCon.u_s
uOpeMod -> intEqu.u1
u1SupFan -> damLimCon.trigger
u1SupFan -> and3.u1
damLimCon.y -> minRetDam.u
damLimCon.y -> minOutDam.u
outDamPhyPosMinSig.y -> outDamPosMaxSwitch.u1
outDamPhyPosMinSig.y -> minOutDam.f1
outDamPhyPosMaxSig.y -> outDamPosMaxSwitch.u3
retDamPhyPosMinSig.y -> retDamPosMinSwitch.u3
retDamPhyPosMaxSig.y -> retDamPosMinSwitch.u1
retDamPhyPosMaxSig.y -> minRetDam.f1
retDamPhyPosMaxSig.y -> yRetDamPhy_max
minSigLim.y -> minOutDam.x1
maxSigLim.y -> minRetDam.x2
sigFraForOutDam.y -> minRetDam.x1
sigFraForOutDam.y -> minOutDam.x2
minOutDam.y -> yOutDam_min
minRetDam.y -> yRetDam_max
retDamPosMinSwitch.y -> minRetDam.f2
retDamPosMinSwitch.y -> yRetDam_min
outDamPosMaxSwitch.y -> minOutDam.f2
outDamPosMaxSwitch.y -> yOutDam_max
not1.y -> retDamPosMinSwitch.u2
not1.y -> outDamPosMaxSwitch.u2
conInt1.y -> intEqu.u2
intEqu.y -> and3.u2
and3.y -> not1.u
and3.y -> yEnaMinOut
--- stderr
